title: Iran names Khamenei’s hardline son Mojtaba as new supreme leader
byline: Iran on Monday named Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his father Ali Khamenei as Supreme Leader, signaling that hardliners remain firmly in charge in Tehran a week into its conflict with the United States and Israel.

title: Dollar surges as US-Iran war pushes oil past $100 a barrel
byline: The dollar took another leg higher on Monday, jumping to a three-month peak on the euro as oil surged past $100 a barrel, stocks slid and investors headed for safety as protracted war in the Middle East threatened to disrupt global energy supplies.

title: Mainly dry weather expected in most parts of the island today
byline: Mainly dry weather will prevail over the island, except for showers or thundershowers that may occur at a few places in Rathnapura, Kaluthara, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 pm, today (09), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Iranian army says at least 104 killed in US attack on Iranian warship off Sri Lanka’s coast
byline: The Iranian army said on Sunday that at least 104 people were killed and 32 were wounded in an attack by ⁠the U.S. on an Iranian warship off Sri Lanka’s coast last week.

title: Iran launches first missiles at Israel under new leader
byline: Iran has launched its first wave of missiles under its new leader Mojtaba Khamenei, state broadcaster IRIB said in a post on its Telegram channel.

title: Over 3,600 road accidents reported in Sri Lanka within first two months of 2026 - Police
byline: Sri Lanka Police stated that more than 3,600 road accidents have been recorded within the first two months of the year.

title: Huge fire in Scotland triggers train chaos as historic building partially collapses
byline: A massive fire near one of Scotland’s busiest train stations has engulfed a historic building in Glasgow, causing it to partially collapse.

title: Jennifer Runyon, ‘Ghostbusters’ and ‘Charles in Charge’ actress, dies at 65
byline: Jennifer Runyon, an actress known for her roles in ‘‘Ghostbusters’’ and the CBS sitcom ‘‘Charles in Charge,’’ died March 6. She was 65.

title: Ex-Ministers Mahindananda and Nalin Fernando produced before court
byline: Former ministers Mahindananda Aluthgamage and Nalin Fernando, who were sentenced to rigorous imprisonment and appealed against their convictions on corruption charges, have been produced before the Supreme Court by prison officials.

title: Trump says ending war will be ‘mutual’ decision with Netanyahu
byline: Donald Trump has said a decision on when to end the war with Iran will be a “mutual” one that he will make with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, The Times of Israel reports.

title: 24-year-old businessman arrested with foreign-manufactured cigarettes at BIA
byline: A Sri Lankan passenger has been arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) by officers of the Airport Police Narcotics Bureau (PNB) while attempting to smuggle a consignment of foreign-manufactured cigarettes into the country.

title: 19-year-old arrested over reckless motorcycle riding video circulating on social media
byline: A 19-year-old youth has been arrested by Police in connection with a video circulated on social media showing a motorcycle being ridden in a reckless and dangerous manner.

title: Govt’s responsibility to ensure women’s rights are realized in everyday life, not just in laws – PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya stated that it is the responsibility of the government to ensure that the political, economic, and social rights of women are not confined merely to laws or written documents, but are realized in the daily lives of every woman in the country.

title: Sri Lanka in “much better position” to handle oil price shocks - CBSL Governor
byline: The Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe has assured the public that Sri Lanka is now in a “much better position” to withstand global economic shocks, including rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

title: At least 32 injured in Bahrain after drone attack - state media
byline: At least 32 people were injured in Bahrain after an Iranian drone attack near the capital, according to a report by the state owned Bahrain News Agency.

title: Indian national arrested with over 2.7 kg of ‘Kush’ at BIA
byline: A foreign passenger has been arrested earlier today (09) by officers of the Airport Police Narcotics Bureau (PNB) while attempting to leave the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) with a stock of ‘‘Kush’‘ cannabis.

title: Oil is now up 25% and on track for a record daily jump
byline: Oil prices surged more than 25% on Monday to their highest levels since mid-2022.

title: CEB dissolved; six new companies take over operations
byline: The six new companies established through the dissolution of the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) have officially come into effect today (09), following the conclusion of the Board’s tenure as of midnight yesterday.

title: Bus strike on 143 Hanwella–Colombo route
byline: Private bus operators on the Hanwella–Colombo Route (143) have reportedly commenced a strike.

title: Youth arrested with ‘Ice’ during vehicle inspection in Dodangoda
byline: During a vehicle inspection operation conducted under the island-wide anti-drug operation, a suspect involved in Crystal Methamphetamine (commonly known as ‘Ice’) drug trafficking across Dodangoda and surrounding areas has been arrested by Dodangoda Police.

title: Prohibition orders issued for 15 defective vehicles in Horana
byline: Prohibition orders have been issued for fifteen defective vehicles identified during a special inspection operation conducted within the Horana Police division, the Horana Police announced.

title: Bruno Mars’ ‘The Romantic’ becomes his first to debut at No. 1 on albums chart
byline: Bruno Mars’s latest album “The Romantic” has debuted at No. 1 on the albums chart, making it his first full-length project to bow atop the tally.

title: IMF warns war could push global inflation higher
byline: The International Monetary Fund is warning the Middle East conflict poses risks for global inflation and has made energy security a top concern.

title: G7 to discuss joint release of emergency oil reserves
byline: G7 finance ministers will discuss a possible joint release of petroleum from reserves co-ordinated by the International Energy Agency, in an emergency meeting on Monday aimed at tackling the surge in oil prices following the conflict in the Gulf.

title: PM Harini departs for Manila to attend ADB International Women’s Day events
byline: The Prime Minister of Sri Lanka, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, departed for Manila, Philippines, at midnight yesterday (8 March) to undertake an official visit at the invitation of the Asian Development Bank (ADB), to participate in events marking International Women’s Day.

title: SriLankan Airlines announces resumption of daily flights to Riyadh and Dubai
byline: SriLankan Airlines has announced that it will resume daily flights to Riyadh and Dubai following the suspension of regular flights amidst the on-going conflict in the Middle East.

title: Iran says no room for ceasefire talks while military attacks continue
byline: Iran said on Monday there was no room to discuss a ceasefire while military attacks by the United States and Israel continue.

title: Sri Lanka to decide fate of Iranian sailors after diplomatic meeting
byline: A discussion is scheduled to be held today (09) between government authorities and officials of the Iranian Embassy in Sri Lanka regarding the next steps to be taken concerning the Iranian sailors currently in Sri Lankan custody.

title: Iran conflict forces central banks into sharp policy rethink
byline: The escalating crisis in the Middle East has dramatically changed the outlook for global central banks, with the huge supply shock posing a difficult trade-off between underpinning growth and countering inflation.

title: Russian President Putin congratulates Iran’s new supreme leader
byline: Russian President Vladimir Putin has written to Iran’s new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to congratulate him, according to the Kremlin.

title: Qatar condemns Iranian attack on residential facility in Saudi Arabia’s Al-Kharj
byline: The government of Qatar has strongly condemned an attack attributed to Iran that targeted a residential facility in Al-Kharj, a city in Saudi Arabia, resulting in the deaths of two civilians and leaving several others injured.

title: South Korea introduces first fuel price cap in 30 years as oil soars past $100
byline: South Korea will impose its first fuel price cap in almost 30 years as global jitters deepen over spiraling oil prices.

title: CEB trade unions to withdraw from all services for 24 hours
byline: Around 25 trade unions attached to the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) have decided to withdraw from all services for 24 hours from 3:00 p.m. today (09).

title: China says it opposes any targeting of new Iran Supreme leader
byline: China said Monday that Iran’s decision to name Mojtaba Khamenei as its new supreme leader following the killing of his father was a domestic matter, and it opposed any attempt to target him.

title: SC to hear Pillayan’s FR petition challenging arrest on March 18
byline: The Supreme Court has ordered that the Fundamental Rights (FR) petition filed by former State Minister Sivanesathurai Chandrakanthan, alias Pillayan, be called on March 18.

title: Ex-MP Sajin Vass Gunawardena arrested by Bribery Commission
byline: Former Member of Parliament Sajin Vass Gunawardena has been arrested by officials of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) over allegations of earning illegal assets worth Rs. 243.8 million.

title: CBSL Governor shares insights on navigating economic crisis at ‘Asia in 2050’ conference
byline: The Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL), P. Nandalal Weerasinghe, participated in a high-level discussion on the Asia-Pacific’s evolving role in the global economy at the Asia in 2050 Conference held recently.

title: One killed, two injured after Iranian missile hits central Israel
byline: An individual has been killed and two others sustained injuries in an Iranian missile attack in central Israel, Israeli medics said Monday.

title: China’s Middle East envoy in Saudi Arabia to mediate Iran war
byline: The Chinese government’s special envoy for Middle East affairs Zhai Jun has visited Saudi Arabia as part of his mediation of the US-Israel war with Iran, saying Beijing is willing to work with Riyadh to make “unremitting efforts to maintain peace and stability in the Gulf region”.

title: British tourist killed in train accident near Wadduwa
byline: An 82-year-old British tourist has died after being struck by a train this evening (09) while standing on a railway bridge between the Wadduwa and Pinwatta railway stations.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for three provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Western, North-western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and the Monaragala district.

title: Investigation further suggests it was the US that struck an Iranian school, killing 165
byline: The investigative group Bellingcat says newly released video “appears to contradict” U.S. President Donald Trump’s claim that Iran was responsible for an explosion at an Iranian school that killed over 165 people at the start of the war raging in the Mideast.

title: Increased Mahapola scholarship allowance to be credited from tomorrow
byline: The increased Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship allowance, introduced under the 2026 Budget proposal, will be credited to students’ bank accounts starting tomorrow (10).

title: Ex-MP Sajin Vass Gunawardena remanded
byline: Former Member of Parliament Sajin Vass Gunawardena, who was arrested by officials of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption earlier today has been remanded.

title: 58-year-old woman involved in drug trafficking arrested in Hatton
byline: A woman who had been involved in drug trafficking in Hatton for several years has been arrested by the Special Investigation Unit of the Hatton Police Division.

title: Lebanon “ready to resume negotiations” with Israel, says prime minister
byline: Lebanon’s government is “ready to resume negotiations” with Israel, the country’s prime minister told local media Monday, as Israeli attacks on the country persisted overnight.

title: President receives blessings from Ven. Ittapana Dhammalankara Thero
byline: The Most Venerable Ittapana Dhammalankara Mahanayake Thera, the Mahanayake of the Kotte Sri Kalyani Samagri Dharma Maha Sangha Sabha and the Chancellor of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura met President Anura Kumara Dissanayake this afternoon (09) at the Presidential Secretariat.

title: USS Abraham Lincoln spotted in Arabian sea
byline: The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln was seen on weekend off the coast of Oman, sailing northwest in the direction of the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Electricity distribution functions transferred to EDL under power sector reforms
byline: Under the electricity sector reforms introduced through the Electricity Act No. 36 of 2024, the responsibility for electricity distribution functions previously carried out by the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) has been transferred to Electricity Distribution Lanka (Private) Limited (EDL).

title: US gas prices up 50 cents since the war with Iran started
byline: US gas prices edged up about 3 cents in the latest reading from AAA. That was the smallest increase in the past week, lifting the price for a gallon of regular to $3.48.

title: Fuel prices increased
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (Ceypetco) has announced a revision of fuel prices effective from midnight today (09).
